unusedPopupDraft.previewPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a restrained redesigned MapleStory-style 2D fantasy game leaderboard screen, wide 1920x1080 composition.
Reference image 1 is the CURRENT ranking screen and defines existing content and functionality. Reference image 2 is the approved wood-panel visual style ONLY.
Replace the sprawling gold sidebar and wall-to-wall ranking layout with ONE centered chestnut wooden board occupying x=360..1560, y=127..917 (1200x790) on the 1920x1080 canvas. VERY IMPORTANT: generous balanced empty margins on both sides for mobile landscape. Do not enlarge it beyond this width.
Use warm medium chestnut wood, thin caramel wood bevel, crisp dark brown outlines, matte hand-painted MapleStory cartoon finish; no metallic gold trim, ornate scrollwork, big crystal piles, elaborate vines, podiums, huge decorative banners, perspective, blur, or glass.
Only a tiny 3-leaf sprig at the top-left board corner. In the header reuse the existing small gray-robed wizard icon at the left of the title; title centered "랭킹", cream native-looking text. Keep all current functional pieces: TWO green pill/rounded wood buttons labeled "무제한 랭킹" and "타임어택 랭킹" side by side below the title; first selected, second muted; column header "순위", "이름", "점수"; three compact fixed rows with the original small gold/silver/bronze rank medal icons, first row JN / 1,193 and empty '-' in rows 2,3; a quiet scrollable list area below these rows, with 4,5,6,7 sample rows; bottom fixed pale-warm row labeled "내 순위" with 1 / JN / 1,193. Preserve the small original bright green gem scrollbar handle. All text crisp cream or dark brown. Rows should have thin understated separators and subtle translucent beige shading, not heavy framed cards.
Behind the centered panel leave a softly darkened Maple village lobby background. Keep the original top-right two currency badges and bottom lobby navigation icons/labels as seen in the current screen. No close X; this is a lobby tab, not a modal.
Composition must feel spacious and functional, with generous outer side margins and readable table columns. All Korean labels spelled exactly.

assets.name: ranking_panel_board_v1
assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Create ONE production UI sprite: the simple chestnut wood leaderboard panel from reference image 1, isolated on real transparent alpha, WITHOUT ANY CONTENT. Reference 1 is the approved design direction, reference 2 the wood palette/style.
The physical wooden board should be a wide landscape rounded rectangle, width:height EXACTLY about 1200:790 (1.52:1). Render straight-on, symmetric flat 2D. A thin warm caramel WOOD bevel, dark brown inner edge and a quiet mid-brown smooth chestnut grain center. Keep the frame modest and thin (about 20px at 1200px visual width). Only THREE small green leaves at the upper-left corner, projecting at most 12px outside the frame. No other decorations. No mushrooms, crystals, characters, gold metal, banners, symbols, buttons, rows, grid, seams across the middle, title, writing, letters, numerals, shadow scene, checkerboard, or background.
Large uninterrupted empty wooden center. Crisp restrained MapleStory-inspired hand-painted 2D cartoon art with clean dark outlines and subtle brushwork. Match reference 1's board, but REMOVE all text, wizard, currency, tabs, table, medals, scrollbar and lobby. Board itself opaque, everything outside fully transparent. Include small transparent outer padding, show all four edges uncut. One independent reusable background asset only.
